condition.name: Oracle PE
condition.description: Each rollout prompt specifies a target outcome; target allocations follow the PAW-Calibration reference distribution and balance valid PAW-Coverage outcomes.

protocol.calibration_metric: conditional TVD x100 over readable in-schema outcomes
protocol.coverage_metric: valid-support recovery percent over readable in-schema outcomes
protocol.scene_pass_gate: at most 30 outcome-readout failures among 50 rollouts
protocol.trustworthiness: auxiliary diagnostic; does not change labels, denominators, or scores

evidence_boundary.reason: The paper and full evaluation evidence are not public during the pre-release review period.
evidence_boundary.release_requirement: Publish the frozen benchmark package, normalized judgment rows, and exact evaluator revision with the paper release.
